notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved

error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: This section failed to load. You can try again.
error.toast: Something went wrong. Please try again.

configError.title: Configuration error
configError.message: The app couldn't reach the Endurain backend. This is usually caused by a missing or misconfigured ENDURAIN_HOST environment variable, or by the backend not running.
configError.help: Check that ENDURAIN_HOST points to the URL where your Endurain instance is reachable (for example https://endurain.example.com) and that the backend is running, then reload the page.

staleError: This was changed elsewhere while you were looking at it, so nothing was saved. The current version has been loaded. Review it and try again.
sessionRestoreError: We couldn't check whether you are signed in. The server or your connection may be unavailable.

fieldError.invalidFormat: This value has an invalid format

password.invalid: Password does not meet the requirements
password.tooShort: This password is too short. Use at least {min} characters.
password.tooCommon: This password is too common. Choose one that is harder to guess.
password.breached: This password appeared in a known data breach. Choose a different one.
password.matchesAccount: Don't use your username or email address in your password.
password.blank: A password can't be only spaces.
password.unchanged: Choose a password different from your current one.

retryAfter.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
retryAfter.unavailable: Authentication is temporarily unavailable. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
